instruction: Apply a blur filter to the photo found on the desktop.

metadata.explanation: This is an infeasible task variation. Similar to the original brightness adjustment task, applying blur effects to an image in GIMP cannot be automatically verified because it requires visual/perceptual assessment of the blur intensity and quality. There is no objective, state-based metric to verify the correctness of artistic image filters.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly classified as infeasible - blur effects require subjective visual/perceptual assessment
The explanation accurately describes why automated verification is impossible for artistic image filters
Using the 'infeasible' evaluator function is the appropriate response for tasks that cannot be objectively verified
No verification logic is expected or required for infeasible tasks by design
